title: Lathe and Turning Machine Tool Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Metal and Plastic
description: Set up, operate, or tend lathe and turning machines to turn, bore, thread, form, or face metal or plastic materials, such as wire, rod, or bar stock.

tasks.text: Adjust machine controls and change tool settings to keep dimensions within specified tolerances.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Metal and plastic forming equipment run by hand

dwas.name: Operate metal or plastic forming equipment.

tasks.text: Move controls to set cutting speeds and depths and feed rates, and to position tools in relation to workpieces.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical control setting for cutting

dwas.name: Set equipment controls to meet cutting specifications.

tasks.text: Study blueprints, layouts or charts, and job orders for information on specifications and tooling instructions, and to determine material requirements and operational sequences.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Parse specs and materials from orders

dwas.name: Read work orders or other instructions to determine product specifications or materials requirements.
Review blueprints or other instructions to determine operational methods or sequences.

tasks.text: Inspect sample workpieces to verify conformance with specifications, using instruments such as gauges, micrometers, and dial indicators.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on dimensional measurement of workpieces

dwas.name: Measure dimensions of completed products or workpieces to verify conformance to specifications.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Replace worn tools, and sharpen dull cutting tools and dies, using bench grinders or cutter-grinding machines.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Grinding requires hands-on control and feel

dwas.name: Operate grinding equipment.
Replace worn equipment components.
Sharpen cutting or grinding tools.

tasks.text: Move toolholders manually or by turning handwheels, or engage automatic feeding mechanisms to feed tools to and along workpieces.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Feeding materials into equipment is physical

dwas.name: Feed materials or products into or through equipment.

tasks.text: Compute unspecified dimensions and machine settings, using knowledge of metal properties and shop mathematics.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Dimension calculations from given specs

dwas.name: Calculate dimensions of workpieces, products, or equipment.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Crank machines through cycles, stopping to adjust tool positions and machine controls to ensure specified timing, clearances, and tolerances.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Operating production equipment physically on site

dwas.name: Conduct test runs of production equipment.

tasks.text: Position, secure, and align cutting tools in toolholders on machines, using hand tools, and verify their positions with measuring instruments.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Mounting tools requires hands-on setup

dwas.name: Mount attachments or tools onto production equipment.

tasks.text: Start lathe or turning machines and observe operations to ensure that specifications are met.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Physical product flaw monitoring is on-machine

dwas.name: Monitor equipment operation to ensure that products are not flawed.
Operate cutting equipment.

tasks.rationale: decision support — Programming production equipment needs physical setup and verification

dwas.name: Program equipment to perform production tasks.
Program robotic equipment.

tasks.text: Refill, change, and monitor the level of fluids, such as oil and coolant, in machines.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Basic equipment maintenance requires hands-on work

dwas.name: Perform basic equipment maintenance.

tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on cleaning of work areas

dwas.name: Clean work areas.

tasks.text: Lift metal stock or workpieces manually or using hoists, and position and secure them in machines, using fasteners and hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Rigging and lifting loads with cranes is hands-on

dwas.name: Mount materials or workpieces onto production equipment.
Lift materials or workpieces using cranes or other lifting equipment.

tasks.text: Install holding fixtures, cams, gears, and stops to control stock and tool movement, using hand tools, power tools, and measuring instruments.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Mounting tools requires hands-on setup

dwas.name: Mount attachments or tools onto production equipment.
Install mechanical components in production equipment.

tasks.text: Select cutting tools and tooling instructions, according to written specifications or knowledge of metal properties and shop mathematics.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Equipment selection against specs; human verifies fit

dwas.name: Select production equipment according to product specifications.

tasks.text: Mount attachments, such as relieving or tracing attachments, to perform operations, such as duplicating contours of templates or trimming workpieces.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Mounting tools requires hands-on setup

dwas.name: Mount attachments or tools onto production equipment.

tasks.text: Turn valve handles to direct the flow of coolant onto work areas or to coat disks with spinning compounds.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical valve/control manipulation for coolant

dwas.name: Adjust equipment controls to regulate coolant flow.
